title: Sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- branch -->
    <rect x='4' y='60' width='92' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
    <rect x='4' y='60' width='92' height='3.5' rx='1.7' fill='#b07a45'/>
    <!-- leaf on branch -->
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='57' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#4caf50' transform='rotate(-18 20 57)'/>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='57' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#66bb6a' transform='rotate(16 82 57)'/>
    <!-- hanging arm/legs over branch -->
    <rect x='40' y='52' width='7' height='16' rx='3.5' fill='#8d6e4f'/>
    <rect x='58' y='52' width='7' height='16' rx='3.5' fill='#8d6e4f'/>
    <!-- claws -->
    <path d='M41 68 l0 5 M44 68 l0 5 M46 68 l0 5' stroke='#e8d8b8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M59 68 l0 5 M62 68 l0 5 M64 68 l0 5' stroke='#e8d8b8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='47' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#a8815a'/>
    <!-- belly lighter -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='50' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#d6b98c'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='52' cy='28' r='17' fill='#b58f63'/>
    <!-- face mask lighter -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='31' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#e8d3ad'/>
    <!-- eye patches -->
    <ellipse cx='45' cy='29' rx='5.5' ry='4.5' fill='#5b4632' transform='rotate(-15 45 29)'/>
    <ellipse cx='59' cy='29' rx='5.5' ry='4.5' fill='#5b4632' transform='rotate(15 59 29)'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='45' cy='29' r='2.4' fill='#26180e'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='29' r='2.4' fill='#26180e'/>
    <circle cx='45.8' cy='28.2' r='0.8' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <circle cx='59.8' cy='28.2' r='0.8' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='35' rx='3' ry='2.3' fill='#4a3524'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M48 38 q4 3.5 8 0' stroke='#6b5038' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- ear tufts -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='20' r='4' fill='#a8815a'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='20' r='4' fill='#a8815a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
